Dear [Admissions Committee/Recipient's Name],  

I have known Eliott Marchand since his undergraduate years, during which he collaborated on a natural language processing project analyzing social media sentiment for ad campaign optimization. As a professor, I’ve observed his growth from a curious student to a thoughtful engineer at AdVerve Technologies, where he specializes in recommendation systems.  

Eliott’s strengths lie in his ability to bridge theoretical insights with practical applications. His work on refining AdVerve’s targeting algorithms demonstrated a deep understanding of NLP, particularly in parsing user intent from unstructured data. He also consistently leverages Python to streamline data pipelines, often simplifying complex workflows for his team. These skills are evident in his recent project, where he redesigned a legacy recommendation engine to prioritize contextual relevance, resulting in a measurable increase in user engagement.  

What stands out is his methodical approach and willingness to iterate. During a late-stage debugging session, Eliott spent hours refining a model’s hyperparameters, ultimately resolving an edge-case issue that had stumped the team. His curiosity and resilience are complemented by a collaborative spirit—he frequently mentors junior engineers and shares insights during cross-departmental brainstorming.  

Eliott’s technical acumen and intellectual humility make him a valuable contributor. I am confident he will excel in any role that demands both precision and creativity.  

Sincerely,  
[Professor’s Full Name]  
[University/Institution]
